summary: Sandbach United are gearing up for the 2026/27 season with an exciting new squad featuring three brand new kits and some fantastic additions plus a returning player. The Ramblers had a tough pre-season outing against St Helens last weekend, but with just one week until the campaign kicks off, the club is looking for sponsorship partners to support their promotion quest. Get behind the team and keep an eye out for more player announcements coming soon!
